preconditions.description: The number of stations n must be between 3 and 3000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in passages)
preconditions.description: Each station index in the passages must be within the range from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(passages) == n and all(xi != yi for xi, yi in passages)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n passages, and no passage can connect a station to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers representing the distances from the ringroad.
All output distances must be non-negative integers.
At least one station must have a distance of 0, indicating it is part of the ringroad.
